questions.question:
If '+' means '÷' , '-' means '+', '×' means '-' and '÷' means '×', what will be the value of the following expression?

[{(49 × 12) - (6 ÷ 2)} + (4 - 3)] ÷ 5

In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'A - B' means 'A is the mother of B',

'A × B' means 'A is the father of B' and

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the son of B'.

If P × Q × R + D ÷ S - B, then which of the following statements is NOT correct?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 ÷
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Father

 
 Son
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

Statement given : P × Q × R + D ÷ S - B

So,

 
• P × Q → P is the father of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc32f09b4b94a4afeb47fce52b7a660d593d6473d6ae0f9c001ff066fa09b066.png] 

 
• Q × R → Q is the father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6dee2a458a149463c0dc2229867892c3d313aaddd25d9dfad0d3e95d96cbd6d.png] 

 
• R + D → R is the brother of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91c6e802a67b9948cf56670b6d9881d4735e733cd836c6e4a6e88331e0101f91.png] 

 
• D ÷ S → D is the son of S.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2fe26cdd3b19fc5afaabc23802c4d9c6d6b6cde0f44bfa8753975524733d160.png] 

 
• S - B → S is the mother of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/770be6986d723e0748214fe4df0aa309dadb6ae0ad0dc78e37c67500ad293788.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree :-

 
• Option - (1) : R is B's brother. ⇒ This statement is correct
 
• Option - (2) : Q is B's father. ⇒ This statement is correct
 
• **Option - (3) : P is B's mother's father. ⇒ This statement is incorrect as P is paternal grandfather of B.**
 
• Option - (4) : R is P's son's son. ⇒ This statement is correct

**Here, "P is B's mother's father" statement is incorrect.**

Hence, "Option - (3)" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All gels are boats.

All pumps are boats.

All boats are ships.

**Conclusions:**

I. All pumps are ships.

II. All ships are gels.

III. Some ships are pumps.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/350131873faa477eff3b516f1e1bac12f57b28993f5034add778cdebe4d42887.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All pumps are ships → Follow (As, all pumps are boats and all boats are ships. So, as whole pumps comes in boats which whole comes in ships, therefore it is definitely true.)

II. All ships are gels → Does not follow (As, all gels are boats and all boats are ships. So, it is possible but not definitely true.)

III. Some ships are pumps → Follow (As, all pumps are boats and all boats are ships. So, as whole pumps comes in boats which whole comes in ships, therefore it is definitely true.)

So, Only conclusions I and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusions I and III follow".
